test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

Had you been to Dubai, __I would also go__ with you.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the **incorrect verb tense** used in the second clause.
 
• In conditional sentences of this type (third conditional), the correct structure is** "would have" **followed by the past participle of the verb.
 
• The correct phrase should be** "I would have gone,"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Had you been to Dubai, **I would have gone** with you."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "I would has also gone" **– This option is incorrect as "would has" is not a valid construction; it should be "would have".
 
• **Option 3: "I will have went" **– This option is incorrect as "will have went" is not grammatically correct; it should be "would have gone".
 
• **Option 4: "I shall be gone" **– This option is incorrect as it does not fit the context of the sentence.
